arguments.sql:
SELECT s.DOCType, t.rtype, typeof(t.NumGE1500) AS count_type, COUNT(*) AS records, MAX(t.NumGE1500) AS largest_count
FROM main.schools AS s
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType LIKE '%State%'
GROUP BY s.DOCType, t.rtype, typeof(t.NumGE1500)

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT s.School, s.AdmEmail1, t.NumGE1500
    FROM main.schools AS s
    JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
      AND t.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT School, AdmEmail1
FROM eligible_schools
WHERE NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM eligible_schools)
ORDER BY School
LIMIT -1
